description: This is the main startup class for the OFBiz framework, implementing a thread-safe server state machine, handling startup commands, and managing server lifecycle states.

classes.name: Start
classes.description: Main class managing the OFBiz server startup, shutdown, and status, implementing a singleton pattern and a thread-safe state machine.

classes.name: Start.ServerState
classes.description: Enum representing the server's possible states: STARTING, RUNNING, STOPPING.

classes.name: Start.CommandType
classes.description: Enum for dispatching startup commands: HELP, STATUS, SHUTDOWN, START.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing OFBiz commands such as start, stop, status, or help.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Start class.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the server and exits the application.
